newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close lower, spec selling noted.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close lower, spec selling noted.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed lower, erasing gains made over the past two days and ignoring the potential for heavy rains from Tropical Storm Lili.
Traders said speculative selling accounted for the bulk of today's volume, estimated at 1,900 lots. Stops were hit around 105.00 in January, pressuring the market to the day's lows, dealers said.
The spot-November contract closed down 3.00 to 111.80, while most-active January settled 1.65 lower, having ranged from 106.25 to 103.60.

Tropical Storm Lili neared the Florida keys and could become a hurricane later today, forecasters said. At 1400 EDT/1800 GMT, the storm was near latitude 18.3 north and longitude 84.5 west, about 365 miles (585 km) south-southwest of Havana.
Maximum sustained winds had strengthened to 65 mph (100 kph). Forecasters said the storm could dump up to 12 inches of rain on parts of Cuba and Central America.
